_doc: OWNER (design/godot-owner-mode.md 'Pictures'): the surfaces the owner can put his own pictures on, found in the wing's meshes at run time by material name (scripts/pictures.gd). framed: the framed newspaper ads (tools/stores/posters/posters.gd), whose frame is rebuilt to the new picture's aspect; panels: poster and ad panels (window posters, lit poster stands, wall poster slots), where the picture is fitted inside the panel on a dark backing. Remove a material from panels to take its surfaces out of Edit pictures.
